description.en: The information about applications related to the lane.
Specifies whether to enable the throttling rule.
The ID of the lane group.

description.zh:
自定义命名空间的RegionId。
格式为：`物理Region:自定义命名空间标识符`，例如`cn-hangzhou:test`。
description.en: The ID of the custom namespace. The ID is in the `physical region ID:custom namespace identifier` format. Example: `cn-hangzhou:test`.
